Transformers were introduced in the 2017 paper "Attention Is All You Need".[1] They have since become the dominant architecture for NLP.[2][3]

The architecture consists of an encoder and a decoder.[4] However, many modern models use decoder-only variants.[5]

Training large transformers requires significant computational resources.[7] This has led to research into more efficient architectures.[8][9]

Some claims remain controversial.[citation needed] Others are considered original research.[original research?]

References

  1. Vaswani et al., "Attention Is All You Need", NeurIPS 2017
  2. Devlin et al., "BERT", NAACL 2019
  3. Brown et al., "GPT-3", NeurIPS 2020
